INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.

2. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.

   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.

4. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Avoid speaking to classmates
   C. Only memorise without using the language
